name: censorify
description: A chrome extension to censor the webpage's text

scripts.build: browserify src/content.ts -p [ tsify --noImplicitAny -p src ] -o src/bundle.js && browserify src/popup/popup.ts -p [ tsify --noImplicitAny -p src/popup ] -o src/popup/bundle.js
scripts.package: npm run build && mkdir -p ../builds && rm -f ../builds/censorify-chrome-$npm_package_version.zip && zip -r ../builds/censorify-chrome-$npm_package_version.zip manifest.json src -x '*.ts' '*tsconfig.json' 'src/data/*' '*.DS_Store'
